deposit_metadata.title: BioInterfaceOS v0.1.3-r10.50: three-cohort biological common-target execution
deposit_metadata.description: Immutable public software version containing the T265 full-text paper-data route, three independent laboratory biological common-target execution, source-held-out nested evaluation, cluster uncertainty, negative controls and cross-environment reproducibility evidence.

upload_instructions: Upload the exact source archive and sidecar from an authenticated archive workflow.
Upload the hash-bound manifest as a separate file because it is excluded from its self-hash.
Record the archive DOI, version DOI, immutable record URL and upload timestamp.
Read back the archived manifest and archive bytes and compare both SHA-256 values exactly.
Only after authenticated read-back may doi_archived become true.
claim_boundary: This is deposit preparation metadata, not a DOI or archive receipt. The DOI gate remains open until authenticated deposit and read-back are independently recorded.
